lines.en: I decide to swing by the porn shop to see how Maki’s doing, but the smile on her face tells me all I need to know- which means that I am now going to focus on Osako instead.
lines.zh: 我决定顺路去那家情趣用品店,看看 Maki 最近如何,但她脸上的笑容已经告诉了我需要知道的一切——这意味着,我现在要把注意力转移到 Osako 身上了。

lines.en: I don’t know how these opportunities to embarrass her keep falling into my lap, but I’m glad they are considering that the chances of her ever falling into my lap are essentially zero.
lines.zh: 我不知道这些让她难堪的机会为什么总是自己送上门,但我很高兴它们这么做——毕竟她本人掉进我怀里的概率,基本上为零。

lines.en: If I can’t have her, I can at least make her question her existence on this planet- a common strategy employed by many others like me...Albeit with typically less consistent and successful track records.
lines.zh: 就算得不到她,我至少能让她质疑自己在这个星球上的存在——一种和我同类的人常用的策略……只不过通常战绩没那么稳定、没那么成功。

lines.en: I sigh to myself as my win rate ticks down from 100%% and take my place behind her which, again, is a thing I will never be able to do in the way I want.
lines.zh: 我暗自叹气,胜率从 100% 往下掉,然后在她身后站定——再说一次,这是我永远无法以我想要的方式做到的事。

lines.en: She’s a lesbian- just in case you aren’t quite picking up what I’m putting down here.
lines.zh: 她是蕾丝边——以防你没能完全领会我在此的言下之意。

lines.en: : See this baby right here? This is the DildoSaber- fresh out of the factory and ready to pierce through the heart (Or vagina) of the one you love.

lines.en: : And if blue isn’t your color, never fear! This thing has a grand total of seven color settings. And if what I’ve heard is correct, the glow is so bright you can even see it inside of your partner if the lights are off!
lines.zh: : 如果蓝色不合你的色,千万别怕!这玩意总共有七档颜色设定。而且如果我听来的没错,它的光亮到——关了灯,你都能看见它在你伴侣体内发光!

lines.en: : Is that even safe?
lines.zh: : 那安全吗?

lines.en: : It wouldn’t be on the market if it wasn’t.
lines.zh: : 要是不安全,它就不会上市了。

lines.en: : Plus, if for some reason its handleability isn’t already a strong enough selling point, it also has several vibration settings you can access from the official DildoSaber app.

lines.en: : I don’t know. It seems fun...but I’m not really sure if it fits our style. We’re not really app people.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。看起来挺有意思……但我真不确定合不合我们的风格。我们不算会用 App 的人。

lines.en: : Do you have anything more, uhh...you know-

lines.en: : Hahah...so you...remember...

lines.zh: : 我从不忘记任何一位顾客,Osako Osaka。

lines.zh: : 这我还真不知道该作何感想。

lines.en: : Besides, if I had a dollar for every time I’ve had to pretend to not recognize your partner at school meetings, I’d have enough to afford...maybe a tenth of an official DildoSaber.
lines.zh: : 再说,要是我每次在校务会议上不得不假装认不出你伴侣,都能拿到一美元,那我现在大概攒够了……买下十分之一个官方 DildoSaber 的钱。

lines.zh: : 要么那玩意贵得要死,要么你在这栋楼以外只见过 Wakana 区区几次。

lines.zh: : 哦!抱歉。我太沉迷于官方 DildoSaber 了,都没看到你在那儿。

lines.zh: : 不,完全没关系。让她先——

lines.en: : Oh, fuck.
lines.zh: : 哦,完蛋。

lines.zh: : 她在说谎。我们其实是挚友。她有时候还会把女朋友分享给我。

lines.zh: : 这家店该不会正好在招保安吧?我突然有种强烈冲动,想把离我最近的变态揍个稀烂。

lines.en: : Run, Maki. Run while you still can.

lines.en: : I’m not worried. You see, the official DildoSaber is so heavy-duty that you can also use it as a weapon if you’re ever in a pinch!
lines.zh: : 我不担心。你看,官方 DildoSaber 坚固耐用,紧要关头还能拿来当武器!

lines.en: : And with its collapsible...dildo part, it makes the perfect sex toy and self-defense weapon! Perfect for stuffing into both your bag and your partner!
lines.zh: : 而且它那可折叠的……dildo 部分,让它成为完美的情趣用品兼防身武器!塞进你的包里、塞进你的伴侣里,都完美!

lines.zh: : Osako,我虽然不是蕾丝边,但这把 DildoSaber 听起来相当带劲,不买的话我觉得你是傻子。

lines.en: : Ah-

lines.zh: : 你可以购买官方 DildoSaber 来弥补我,价格低到令人发指,只要——

lines.en: Sensing that her life must be in danger, Maki scurries off- retreating into the back room and, if her dialogue tonight has been any indication of where her personal interests lie, probably testing out the DildoSaber.
lines.zh: 察觉到自己性命必定危在旦夕,Maki 一溜烟跑了——退进后屋,而如果她今晚的台词能说明她个人兴趣之所在的话,大概正在试玩 DildoSaber。

lines.en: : Is nothing sacred anymore?
lines.zh: : 这世上还有什么东西是神圣的吗?

lines.en: : If you were seeking sanctuary in this house of unholiness, I have very bad news for you.
lines.zh: : 如果你是想在这座渎神之屋里寻求庇护,那我有个非常糟糕的消息要告诉你。

lines.en: : Why are you even here?
lines.zh: : 你到底为什么会在这儿?

lines.en: : The same reason you’re here. Because I’m a sex positive adult looking for a good time.
lines.zh: : 和你来的理由一样。因为我是一个性观念健康的成年人,想找点乐子。

lines.en: : Also, I’m friends with Maki and wanted to check in on her.
lines.zh: : 另外,我和 Maki 是朋友,想来看看她。

lines.en: : Then check in on her instead of talking to me. I didn’t ask for this.
lines.zh: : 那就去看看她,别来和我说话。我没要求这种待遇。

lines.zh: : 此刻,我觉得 Maki 最需要的,是和那个新玩具独处的时间。

lines.en: : I think she needs a lot more than that based on what I’ve heard from Wakana about her husband.
lines.zh: : 根据 Wakana 跟我说的她老公的事,我觉得她需要的东西,比那多得多。

lines.zh: : 你说得对。我们应该用身体去给她打气。但得让我先来。

lines.zh: : 在这种地方,我向来放飞自我。毕竟那也是 Maki 想要的。

lines.en: : Yeah...I’ve been avoiding coming here lately for that exact reason. I thought she’d need more time to grieve, but...it looks to me like she’s at least somewhat okay now.
lines.zh: : 是啊……出于完全相同的理由,我最近一直避免来这儿。我以为她需要更多时间哀悼,但……在我看,她现在至少算是有点没事了。

lines.en: : I guess she could always be acting, though.

lines.zh: : 不得不避开这地方,听起来你好像有某种瘾似的,新挚友。

lines.en: : Stop calling me that. And also, stop trying to probe me for information about my sex life. I’m not going to tell you anything.
lines.zh: : 别再那么叫我了。还有,别再试图从我这里打探我性生活的事。我什么都不会告诉你的。

lines.en: : If you’re not going to tell me anything, can I at least ask you an extremely generalized, lesbian-based question that I've always been curious about?
lines.zh: : 要是你什么都不打算说,那至少让我问你一个极其泛泛的、关于蕾丝边的、我长期好奇的问题,行吗?

lines.en: : Is it going to be sexist, insensitive, or the result of blatant obliviousness?
lines.zh: : 它会是性别歧视、麻木不仁,还是全然迟钝的产物?

lines.en: : I just want to know why lesbians still like penis shaped toys but not actual men.
lines.zh: : 我只是想知道,为什么蕾丝边仍然喜欢 penis 形状的玩具,却不喜欢真正的男人。

lines.en: : So yes. It is going to be all three of the things I just said.
lines.zh: : 所以答案是:是。上面三样全占。

lines.en: : You can not blame man for his curiosity.
lines.zh: : 人不能责怪男人的好奇心。

lines.en: : You are free to not have sex with him, though.
lines.zh: : 不过,你也可以选择不和他做爱。

lines.en: : Well, thanks so much for your permission. I really-
lines.zh: : 哦,多谢你的批准。我真——

lines.en: : Makoto.
lines.zh: : Makoto。

lines.en: : In the flesh.
lines.zh: : 本人在此。

lines.en: : What are you doing down here? I didn’t think you were ready to-
lines.zh: : 你怎么下楼来了?我以为你还没准备好——

lines.en: : I’m getting a drink. We’re out of bottled water upstairs.
lines.zh: : 我来拿喝的。楼上的瓶装水没了。

lines.en: : Also, please stop pestering the customers. If you’re looking for a quick release, check the aisle in the back left. New TENGAs, 30%% off. Woohoo.
lines.zh: : 还有,请别再纠缠顾客。如果你在找快速释放,去左后方那条过道看看。新到 TENGA,七折。呼呼。

lines.en: : Makoto! Makoto!
lines.zh: : Makoto!Makoto!

lines.zh: : 看!它们来了!哈。「来了」。而且它们比我想的还酷!

lines.en: : Can you stop waving that thing around? You look like a maniac.
lines.zh: : 你能不能别把那玩意挥来挥去?你像个疯子。

lines.en: : But it’s got an accelerometer in it that gives it that cool whoosh noise like you hear in the movies!
lines.zh: : 可它里面装了加速度计,能发出电影里那种酷炫的呼啸声!

lines.zh: : 你知道吗?也许我就渴死算了。

lines.en: : Noooo, come on! Pick one up! We’ll have an official DildoSaber fight!
lines.zh: : 不要啊,来嘛!拿一把!我们来一场官方 DildoSaber 大战!

lines.en: : So, Osako- would you rather stay here and listen to this? Or come talk to me outside about this secret addiction of yours?

lines.en: : It’s not an addiction. I just...
lines.zh: : 那不是瘾。我只是……

lines.en: : Just what?
lines.zh: : 只是什么?

lines.en: : Just don’t want to talk to you about it. It makes me uncomfortable.
lines.zh: : 只是不想和你聊这个。那让我不自在。

lines.en: : What difference is talking to me about something like this than someone like Maki? As the owner of a penis, I probably know just as much as she does.
lines.zh: : 和我聊这种事,和找 Maki 那样的人聊,有什么区别?作为一个 penis 的持有者,我懂的和她也差不多。

lines.en: : If anything, I feel like it should be easier to talk to me since you have literally zero sexual attraction toward me and have likely fantasized at least once about the owner of this porn shop.

lines.zh: : 谁都会幻想她的,Osako。我已经接受了。这没什么好羞耻的。

lines.en: : Yeah, that’s it. I’m gonna go die now.
lines.zh: : 对,就是现在。我要去死了。

lines.en: : Wait! No! I’ve already lost one!
lines.zh: : 等等!不要!我已经失去过一个了!

lines.en: : Makoto! Come back! I’ll give you a discount on your first official DildoSaber!
lines.zh: : Makoto!回来!你的第一把官方 DildoSaber 我给你打折!

lines.en: : I don’t want a DildoSaber! I want you to pick up more water from the grocery store! The tap water tastes weird!
lines.zh: : 我不要什么 DildoSaber!我要你去杂货店多买点水!自来水喝着怪怪的!

lines.en: : Hah...

lines.zh: : 我猜……在性吸引这件事上,你算是有点说对了。我只是不想让你在这件事上犯怪——毕竟「犯怪」似乎是你唯一真正擅长的。

lines.en: : That might be something I’m good for, sure. But I know when to stop. Kind of.
lines.zh: : 那可能确实是我擅长的事之一。但我知道适可而止。大概吧。

lines.en: : And if you heard my inner monologue, you’d know that I’ve already acknowledged the fact that we’re never going to bang like three or four times tonight alone.
lines.zh: : 再说,你要是听过我的内心独白,就会知道光是今晚,我已经在心里承认过三四次「我们绝不会上床」了。

lines.en: : Three or four? Isn’t that a little too often?

lines.zh: : 要是你不想聊,那完全没问题,剩下的夜晚我很乐意就用来让你难堪、烦你。

lines.en: : I just figured there might be something you want to get off your chest if you’ve been literally and intentionally avoiding this place.
lines.zh: : 我只是觉得,既然你在字面意义上、并且是有意地避开这个地方,也许有些话你憋在心里想一吐为快。

lines.zh: : 就算有,你又能怎样?一个异性恋男人能给我什么沾边有用的性建议?

lines.zh: : 嘿,我们都喜欢女人,不是吗?我们的共同点可能比你以为的多。

lines.zh: : 你能保证这些话绝不向 Wakana 透露半个字吗?

lines.zh: : 还有,不再问那些性别歧视、麻木不仁、全然迟钝的问题?

lines.en: : I will literally just stand there if I have to. Like Maki, I really just want you to find what you’re looking for.
lines.zh: : 必要的话,我真的就站在那儿一言不发。和 Maki 一样,我只是想让你找到你在找的东西。

lines.en: : I doubt I can find it for you but, at the very least, I can walk by your side so you seem less suspicious and don’t feel pressured to just walk away empty-handed.
lines.zh: : 我怀疑我找不到它,但至少,我可以走在你身边,让你看起来不那么可疑,也不会因为压力而空手而归。

lines.en: : Fine. Come on. But I’m breaking your arm the second you get weird.
lines.zh: : 行。来吧。但只要你一犯怪,我就折断你的手臂。

lines.en: Osako and I step outside to avoid the constant pressure to buy a certain sci-fi themed sex toy that even I was relatively impressed by and press our backs against the wall.
lines.zh: Osako 和我走到店外,躲开那股买某个科幻主题情趣玩具的无穷压力——连我都对它颇为印象深刻——然后背靠着墙。

lines.en: It’s quiet enough around here that we should be keeping our voices down, but the lack of any noticeable person outside means we may not have to.
lines.zh: 这一带安静得我们本该压低声音,但外面没有任何显眼的人,意味着我们也许不必。

lines.en: I guess that’s up to Osako, though. It’s not as if I’m about to come clean about my sex life to her when confirming anything at all could prove to be...problematic, if nothing else.

lines.zh: 但我想,如果……那就是另一回事了。

: 所以……

lines.zh: : 把这些告诉你,既是侵犯 Wakana 的隐私,也是侵犯我的。所以这些话要是走漏半个字,我真的会杀你。

lines.zh: : 嗯……在性事上,我们有一种……特定的互动模式。

lines.zh: : 我要强调,那种模式我深爱着……我对它完全没有意见。

lines.en: : But I always feel like I’m not...doing enough for her. Which makes me feel like I...I don’t know, can’t do enough for her.

lines.en: : And any time I try to...take the initiative and change the way things work, she just pulls out an Uno reverse card on me and, before I know it, she’s winning again.
lines.zh: : 而每次我试着……主动出击、改变事情的走向,她就会甩出一张 Uno 反转牌,而等我反应过来,赢的又是她。

lines.en: : Or I guess...losing, by most people’s standards...But why would someone always want to lose when winning feels so much better?
lines.zh: : 或者说……按大多数人的标准,是输……可既然赢的感觉好那么多,为什么会有人总想输呢?

lines.en: : I know a metaphor when I hear one.
lines.zh: : 比喻我一听就知道是比喻。

lines.en: : I just want her to win sometimes too, you know? It feels...unfair. But she’s never shown any sign of wanting that dynamic to change or being unsatisfied and...
lines.zh: : 我只是偶尔也想让她赢一次,你懂吗?那感觉……不公平。但她从没表现出任何想改变这种模式的迹象,也没有任何不满,而且……

lines.en: : I don’t know, man. You know I’ve got some...dependence issues...and confidence issues...and other shit like that. It’s probably just those things going to work again.
lines.zh: : 我不知道,伙计。你知道我有点……依赖问题……和自信问题……以及诸如此类的烂事。多半就是那些毛病又上班了。

lines.en: : I just can’t help but feel like I’m doing something wrong...Can’t help but feel like I’ve gotta try and shake things up in some way.
lines.zh: : 我就是忍不住觉得,我有什么事做错了……忍不住觉得,我必须试着以某种方式撼动一下现状。

lines.en: : Lucky for you, a brand new product just hit the shelves that's sure to light up even the darkest of sex lives.
lines.zh: : 你运气真好,一款全新产品刚刚上架,保证能点亮哪怕最黑暗的性生活。

lines.en: : Don’t you fucking turn on me, man. I swear.
lines.zh: : 你他妈可别在这个当口给我来这套,伙计。我发誓。

lines.en: : I figured a joke might be better than any obsolete, heterosexual advice I might have.
lines.zh: : 我觉得,比起我可能给出的任何过时异性恋建议,一个笑话也许更好。

lines.en: : Just give me normal advice. Human to human. Tell me I’m overthinking this and...manufacturing problems when none really exist.
lines.zh: : 给我正常建议就好。人对人。告诉我这是我想多了,而且……是在凭空制造根本不存在的问题。

lines.en: : Have-
lines.zh: : 你有——

lines.en: : And before you go asking me if I’ve talked to Wakana about it, I have. But she insisted it’s no issue at all.
lines.zh: : 而且趁你去问「你和 Wakana 谈过吗」之前——谈过。但她坚持说根本没问题。

lines.en: : Then it’s no issue at all.
lines.zh: : 那就是根本没问题。

lines.en: : You really believe that?
lines.zh: : 你真信这个?

lines.en: : Doesn’t matter what I believe. What matters is that you trust her and she’s already told you how it is.
lines.zh: : 我信什么不重要。重要的是你信任她,而她已经把实情告诉了你。

lines.en: : If she’s lying, you’ve got much bigger problems on your hands than which one of you cums more frequently.
lines.zh: : 如果她在撒谎,那你手上的问题可比「你们俩谁去得更频繁」大得多。

lines.en: : Okay. Guess my metaphor is dead.
lines.zh: : 好。看来我的比喻死了。

lines.en: : I came out here to listen tonight- not to speak in riddles and pretend to understand what you’re going through.
lines.zh: : 我今晚出来是为了听——不是为了打哑谜,也不是假装理解你在经历什么。

lines.en: : If you’ve got some issues with your sex life, even if those issues aren’t issues according to the person you think has issues...the only person you can work it out with is them.
lines.zh: : 要是你的性生活真有什么问题,哪怕在你认为有问题的人看来那些根本不算问题……唯一能和你就此解开疙瘩的,也只有那个人。

lines.en: : And again, not a lesbian, but I’m pretty sure there isn’t a single sex toy out there that is going to just magically quell all of the worries you’re burdened with at the moment.
lines.zh: : 再说一次,我不是蕾丝边,但我相当确定,世上没有任何一件情趣玩具,能魔法般平息你此刻背负的所有忧虑。

lines.en: : Nothing other than the official DildoSaber, you mean.
lines.zh: : 你是想说,除了官方 DildoSaber 以外没有。

lines.en: : You know, the fact that you decided to talk to me at all instead of just outright purchasing something we already know to be a solution is really bizarre.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗,你居然决定来找我谈,而不是直接买下那个我们已知能解决问题的东西,这件事本身真是匪夷所思。

lines.en: : Believe it or not, there’s a limit to how much torture I can endure. And that seemed a little too large for my tastes.
lines.zh: : 信不信由你,我能忍受的折磨是有限度的。而那玩意似乎有点太大,不合我的口味。

lines.en: : Not really the shape I like either. I prefer them more...authentic.
lines.zh: : 形状也不是我喜欢的那款。我更喜欢更……原汁原味的。

lines.en: : Is my question from earlier really that insensitive? Because I seriously don’t understand how the lesbian brain works and why penises are suddenly cool once they’re not attached to a man anymore.
lines.zh: : 我刚才那个问题真有那么麻木吗?因为我是真的不理解蕾丝边的大脑是怎么运作的,以及为什么 penis 一旦不附着在男人身上,就突然变得酷了起来。

lines.en: : That’s the forbidden question, dude. Asking it is never going to get you the answer you’re looking for.
lines.zh: : 那是禁忌之问,伙计。问它永远不会让你得到你在找的答案。

lines.en: : Fact is, even if I’m not physically attracted to men, they’ve got an appendage that gets the job done. I’m sure there are just as many gay dudes with onaholes tucked away in their nightstands.
lines.zh: : 事实是,就算我对男人没有身体上的性趣,他们也长着一个能把活干完的附属器官。我确信床头柜里藏着飞机杯的男同,一样多的是。

lines.en: : If it feels good...it feels good, I guess.
lines.zh: : 只要感觉好……感觉就好,我猜。

lines.en: : I doubt there’s a limit to the amount of torture you can endure, though. If there is anything I have learned through our brief time together, it’s that you are submissive as all hell.
lines.zh: : 不过我怀疑你能忍受的折磨没有上限。如果在我们短暂的相处里我学到过什么,那就是:你服从得要死。

lines.en: : Or, as Imani put it at the bar recently, you “radiate bottom energy.”
lines.zh: : 或者,用 Imani 最近在酒吧里的说法,你「散发着 bottom 的气场」。

lines.en: : Takes one to know one. I’ll be damned if she doesn’t radiate that same energy right back.
lines.zh: : 彼此彼此。她要是没把同款气场原样反射回来,我名字倒着写。

lines.en: : What kind of energy do I have?
lines.zh: : 那我是什么气场?

lines.en: : You?
: Negative.
lines.zh: : 负能量。

lines.en: : That’s it. We’re not friends anymore.
lines.zh: : 够了。我们绝交了。

lines.en: : Ah! There you guys are.
lines.zh: : 啊!原来你们在这儿。

lines.en: : What’s going on out here? Thinking of going halfsies on an official DildoSaber? Act now and I’ll throw in a full set of anal beads for no cost at all.
lines.zh: : 外面在干什么呢?想合买一把官方 DildoSaber?现在行动,我再免费送你一整套后庭珠。

lines.en: : Is that more up your alley, Osako?
lines.zh: : 这是不是更对你的路子,Osako?

lines.en: : Only if Wakana wants it to be.
lines.zh: : 只有 Wakana 想要的时候才是。

lines.en: : Imani was right. Even I can feel the bottom energy and I have only known about its existence for a few days.
lines.zh: : Imani 说得对。连我都能感觉到那股 bottom 气场,而我几天前才知道它的存在。

lines.en: : Energies aside, I think I found something you might actually be interested in, Osako. But it’d probably be best if I showed you alone. Without Sensei.
lines.zh: : 气场先放一边,我想我找到了一件你可能真会感兴趣的东西,Osako。但最好让我单独给你看。别带 Sensei。

lines.en: : What crazy lesbian toy am I not allowed to know the existence of?
lines.zh: : 什么疯狂的蕾丝边玩具,是不许我知道其存在的?

lines.en: : You coming onto me, Maki?
lines.zh: : 你在勾引我,Maki?

lines.en: : You? When I’ve got a box full of DildoSabers? The Bugatti of sex toys? Don’t make me laugh.
lines.zh: : 你?我这里有一整箱 DildoSaber,情趣玩具中的布加迪的时候?别逗我笑。

lines.en: : Alright, alright. Let’s see what you’ve got.
lines.zh: : 行行行。让我看看你有什么。

lines.en: : Am I really not allowed to see this?
lines.zh: : 我真的不能看这个吗?

lines.en: : Sensei, if you saw this, it would change everything you know about women. It’s best to leave this to us.
lines.zh: : Sensei,你要是看到了这个,你对女性的一切认知都会被改写。这件事还是交给我们比较好。

lines.en: : What does that even mean?
lines.zh: : 这话到底什么意思?

lines.en: : It means it’s time for you to take your little victory and head home. Can’t believe I’ve been actually opening up to you lately. The Hell is going on with me?
lines.zh: : 意思是,该带着你的小胜利回家去了。真不敢相信我最近居然在对你敞开心扉。我到底怎么了?

lines.en: : And don’t say I’m falling in love with you. You were surprisingly bearable tonight, which is weird given the place we ran into one another.
lines.zh: : 还有,别说我爱上你了。你今晚出奇地能忍受,考虑到我们相遇的场所,这很怪。

lines.en: : Wouldn’t want to ruin it now.
lines.zh: : 现在可不想把它毁了。

lines.en: Osako and Maki head back inside to take a look at...whatever sort of device would forever change my opinion about women.
lines.zh: Osako 和 Maki 回到店内,去研究那个……据说会永远改写我对女性之观的装置。

lines.en: I have no idea what that means, so I’m just going to assume it’s actually a mech and that they are planning to take over the world.
lines.zh: 我完全不知道那是什么意思,所以我打算直接假定那其实是一台机甲,而她们正计划征服世界。

lines.en: And while that might not be true, it’s an option that will prevent me from jerking off to the fantasy of sleeping with her regardless of her preferences.
lines.zh: 虽然那可能不是真的,但这个设想至少能阻止我,在无视她性向的前提下,对着和她上床的幻想撸个没完。

lines.en: I’ve been surprisingly bearable tonight.
lines.zh: 我今晚出奇地能忍受。

lines.en: I wouldn’t want to ruin it now.
lines.zh: 现在可不想把它毁了。

lines.en: Osako’s affection has increased to [osako_love]!
lines.zh: Osako 的好感度提升到了 [osako_love]!
